summary.overview: In the recent Business Development Strategy Meeting titled "We Group x Capital A - Weekly Catch Up," team members discussed various crucial aspects of their ongoing business development efforts. The meeting, attended by Heather, Nick, Ahmed, Andrew, and David, began with updates on team locations and travel plans, followed by a review of the lead pipeline, highlighting promising prospects like TXG and Frank, while addressing setbacks with multiple 'no thank you' responses. The discussion around TXG revealed its potential with an estimated $12M revenue and straightforward structure, contrasting with the complexities surrounding Superfly. Deal structure considerations emphasized the importance of evaluating financials before establishing valuations, and the team outlined additional prospects, notably Agency 21, while focusing on businesses within the $10M revenue range. Action items were assigned, including Ahmed creating one-sheet prospect profiles, Heather following up with TXG, and Nick engaging with New York-based prospects during his upcoming trip to the US. Weekly meetings will continue to ensure progress tracking and collaboration among the team.
